.
His

,

.

family

in

.

its
residence
in
Edinburgh
,
it
owned
Press
Estate
,

of

35

city
.

family
often
stayed
at

Castle
,

large

on

northern
edge
of
the
property
,

Alexander

childhood
in
the
area
,
playing
on
the
beach

or

nearby

Even
after

at

.

three
-

an
accountant
.

never

a
business
career
,
he

with

to
please
his
family
.
In
October
1855
,
however
,

to
Canada

his
wife
Agnes
Elder
Robertson
and
they
settled
in
Montreal
.
Henderson
learned
photography
in
Montreal
around
the
year
1857
and
quickly
took
it
up
as
a
serious
amateur
.
He
became
a
personal
friend
and
colleague
of
the
Scottish
-
Canadian
photographer
William
Notman
.
The
two
men
made
a
photographic
excursion
to
Niagara
Falls
in
1860
and
they
cooperated
on
experiments
with
magnesium
flares
as
a
source
of

light
in
1865
.
They
belonged

the
same

and
were
among

of

Art
Association
of

.
